title: Nvidia, Anthropic Weigh In On AI Safeguards
text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said he would halt the supply of chips to a customer that was developing unsafe AI software, though he doesn’t believe that the current level of concern about the technology is warranted. AI executives such as Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei have proposed an industrywide slowdown to address the concerns. Meantime, Anthropic held an investor day Wednesday as it advances plans for a potential IPO at an approximately $2 trillion valuation, amid growing concerns about AI safety and threats. We get reaction from Bloomberg Tech host Ed Ludlow & Jacqueline Corbelli, Co-Founder and CEO at Brightline Partners. (Source: Bloomberg)
